'''Tusken Bread''' was a type of [[Bread/Legends|bread]].

==History==
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Bren Kingal]] gave a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] a plate of Tusken bread.

==Recipe==
Mix 1 cup [[Blue milk/Legends|blue milk]], 1 cup [[Water/Legends|water]], 1 pinch Tusken brew-yeast. Leave in warm place for a while. Mix 1 handful (humanoid hand) mounder [[Flour/Legends|flour]], 3 pinches [[Salt/Legends|salt]]. Slowly add [[Bantha butter/Legends|bantha butter]] until doughy; add brew-yeast mixture. Knead until stiff. Leave in warm place until doubled. Knead briefly, rip hand-size (humanoid hand) pieces of dough, pound flat. Fry over low heat until crisp. Eat immediately. makes 1 plate

==Behind the scenes==
Tusken bread appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
